NO GRASS ANYWHERE — the ground cover is ferns, pale volcanic ash and bare earth. The morning sun stands approximately 2 degrees above the horizon and the ground mist is thick, limiting sight to about 400 metres.

The wrecked capsule sits mid-frame between roughly forty-seven and sixty-eight percent, the gouged trench leading toward it from the foreground. She stands small on the hull at roughly fifty-seven to seventy percent, left of centre, held clear of the outer right eighth. No part of the figure falls into the bottom quarter of the frame; the bottom quarter carries only torn earth and fern cover.
